dense_caption: A wide shot looking into the drum of a Samsung WA5471ABP washing machine. A red rectangular highlight outlines the 'Magic Filter' located on the side wall of the stainless steel drum, set against a blurred Indian household background.
A close-up view of the Magic Filter unit inside the drum. The filter casing is distinct, and a red glow highlights the specific area where the user needs to interact.
A hand is shown reaching into the drum and pressing the release tab at the top of the filter. A red arrow points downwards onto the tab to indicate the pressing action required to unlock it.
The filter is being physically lifted out of its housing on the drum wall. A red dashed line traces the upward movement path, indicating the removal direction.
The open filter is being held under a running water tap in a sink. A red box highlights the mesh area where the water is hitting to flush out the lint.
A close-up showing a hand using a small cleaning brush to gently scrub the filter mesh. A red circle highlights the point of contact between the brush and the mesh.
A hand is aligning the clean filter back into the slot on the washing machine drum wall. Red arrows indicate the alignment points to ensure it fits correctly.
The filter is pressed firmly against the drum wall. A red 'click' graphic or icon is overlaid on the top tab to visualize the locking mechanism engaging.
